name.note: Display name supplied by the developer; API identifier viv-fast.

developer.note: The exact model page calls this Vivgrid’s own model; founder contribution corroborates attribution.

family.note: No broader model family is identified. The original contribution omits family because the schema lacked an enum; that does not establish a technical family relationship.

release_date.note: Explicit release_date in the founder-authored initial contribution, accompanied by the same-day new-model description and API documentation. This is stronger than merely interpreting a catalog first-observed timestamp. No earlier exact-model availability announcement found.

open_weights.note: Developer explicitly marked the exact model closed; documented distribution is hosted API access. Public SDK/research licenses do not release its weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification under Vivgrid’s limited service rights and retained intellectual property; no open-weight license declared.

parameters_b.note: Fresh review found no published nominal total or explicitly named unchanged base model. SLM is qualitative; the provider catalog base_model value refers to Viv Fast itself, while other gateway models are separate offerings.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh separate review found no active-parameter disclosure or exact-model original research comparison supplying an activation convention. Context, pricing, serving-region routing and behavioral fingerprints do not determine active learned weights.

architecture.note: No model network architecture disclosed after checking exact documentation, later articles and public technical research. Geo-distributed routing concerns serving regions. No primary evidence establishes a service-tier alias, composite model router, dense network or MoE.

context_window.note: Exact token limit from developer documentation; 256,000 maximum output is a separate limit.

modalities.note: Developer’s exact-model configuration and initial contribution specify both input modalities and text output.

reasoning.note: Founder-authored contribution explicitly documents reasoning_effort low/high/max. Current model page omits these controls, so the evidence is the dated developer statement, not inferred capability from generic reasoning language. No authenticated inference request was made.

tool_call.note: Exact documentation explicitly supports function calling and provides tool_call true configuration.

parameter_reaudit.total_assessment: No published nominal total or explicit unchanged base lineage found. The conclusion does not require an exact tensor census and does not discard a supported nominal size.
parameter_reaudit.active_assessment: No separately stated active count in current developer sources. Bounded exact-name searches for later original technical reports and activated-parameter comparisons returned the developer specifications, derivative directories or unrelated research, with no qualifying exact Viv Fast research table.
parameter_reaudit.lineage_assessment: Neither similar context/pricing nor related-model links identify a parent model. The catalog override links to vivgrid/viv-fast itself; neighboring DeepSeek and other hosted models remain distinct. Fingerprint tooling is not proof of neural structure or shared weights.
parameter_reaudit.access_limitations: All ten additional originals returned HTTP 200 in the fresh fetch manifest. Parent current model pages also returned HTTP 200 and were inspected. No authenticated inference calls or weight shards requested.
parameter_reaudit.remaining_uncertainty: Both learned-model counts and an explicit base-model identity remain undisclosed in the checked public evidence.
